Assumptions:
This comparison is based on the official technical specifications released by Apple for the standard configurations of both models. "Base" refers to the entry-level configuration, and "Maximum" refers to the highest build-to-order option available.

Summary:
The 2022 MacBook Air (M2) offers a significant upgrade over the 2020 M1 model, featuring a more powerful and efficient chip, a modern flat-edge design, a larger and brighter display, and expanded memory support. While the M1 model remains a powerful machine for everyday tasks, the M2 model provides notable performance gains, particularly in graphics-intensive applications, and introduces key quality-of-life improvements like MagSafe charging and a better webcam.

Comparison Table:
| Specification | 2020 MacBook Air (M1) | 2022 MacBook Air (M2) |
|---|---|---|
| CPU Cores (Base) | 8-core (4 performance, 4 efficiency) | 8-core (4 performance, 4 efficiency) |
| GPU Cores (Base) | 7-core | 8-core |
| Maximum Unified Memory | 16GB | 24GB |
| Weight | 2.8 pounds (1.29 kg) | 2.7 pounds (1.24 kg) |

Key Differences Explained:
*   **Processor Performance**: The M2 chip delivers an 18% faster CPU, a 35% more powerful GPU, and a 40% faster Neural Engine compared to the M1. It also features increased memory bandwidth, which improves multitasking performance.
*   **Design and Display**: The M2 Air has a completely new, uniform-thickness design and is slightly lighter. It boasts a larger 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display that is brighter (500 nits vs. 400 nits) and supports 1 billion colors. This display includes a notch for the camera. The M1 Air retains the classic tapered wedge design with a 13.3-inch Retina display.
*   **Charging and Ports**: The M2 Air brings back the dedicated MagSafe 3 charging port, which frees up its two Thunderbolt / USB 4 ports for accessories even while charging. The M1 Air charges via one of its two Thunderbolt / USB 4 ports.
*   **Camera and Audio**: The M2 model features an upgraded 1080p FaceTime HD camera, providing a much clearer image than the 720p camera on the M1 model. It also has an improved four-speaker sound system.
